payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates all possible starting offsets in t, comparing character-by-character with s, records mismatched positions, and selects the offset that yields the fewest mismatches.
payload.rationale: Brute-force sliding window: tries all O(m) offsets. No backtracking, bitmask, B&B, graph, or permutation enum. Among given subtypes, search_backtracking is selected as closest complete_search method.
